title: PPF — Public Provident Fund
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: PPF is a government-backed long-term savings scheme with a 15-year lock-in (extendable in blocks of 5 years). You can deposit ₹500 to ₹1.5 lakh per financial year. The interest rate is set by the government and reviewed every quarter; it has stayed around 7–7.1% in recent years, so check the current rate. Deposits qualify for the Section 80C deduction under the old tax regime, and the interest and maturity amount are tax-free (EEE). Because it is government-backed the risk is very low, but the money is locked: partial withdrawal is allowed only from the 7th year, and loans are available against the balance in early years. It suits the 'safe' slice of long-term money, not goals under 15 years.
summary_hinglish: PPF sarkari scheme hai, 15 saal ka lock-in, saal mein ₹500 se ₹1.5 lakh tak jama kar sakte ho. Byaj sarkar tay karti hai (abhi 7% ke aas-paas, check kar lo), aur interest aur maturity dono tax-free. Paisa locked rehta hai, 7th saal se partial withdrawal.
summary_hi: PPF सरकारी योजना है, 15 साल का लॉक-इन, साल में ₹500 से ₹1.5 लाख तक जमा कर सकते हैं। ब्याज दर सरकार तय करती है और ब्याज व मैच्योरिटी टैक्स-फ्री है। पैसा लॉक रहता है, 7वें साल से आंशिक निकासी।
